import pandas as pd

data = {
    "batch": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C"],
    "mass_g": [3, 7, 4, 6, 2, 8],
    "volume_ml": [1, 3, 2, 5, 1, 4],
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import seaborn as sns

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
sns.violinplot(data=df, x="batch", y="mass_g", inner=None, cut=0, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set(title="Draft density", xlabel="batch", ylabel="mass_g")
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x="volume_ml", y="mass_g", ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set(title="Paired measurements", xlabel="volume_ml", ylabel="mass_g")

# Your work
for artist in [*axes[0].lines, *axes[0].collections, *axes[0].patches]:
    artist.remove()
sns.stripplot(x=df["batch"], y=df["mass_g"], jitter=False, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set(title="Observations", xlabel="batch", ylabel="mass_g")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
